Murphy Capital Management Holding In Aflac (AFL) Was Has Raised; Cadence Bank Na Trimmed Its Position in Apple (AAPL) as Stock Price Rose
June 19, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Murphy Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Aflac (AFL) by 100.39% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Murphy Capital Management Inc bought 17,920 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.09% with the market. The institutional investor held 35,770 shares of the accident &health insurance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.57M, up from 17,850 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Murphy Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Aflac for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $34.98 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $45.19. About 1.14M shares traded. Aflac Incorporated (NYSE:AFL) has risen 21.38% since June 19, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 8.81% the S&P500.
